At Node Alpha they priced the future in tidy rows:
Standard Rounds Box: 0cr,
Coolant Loop: 0cr,
Armor Plate: 25cr,
Communications Array: 35cr,
Control Node: 40cr.

A free bullet and a free breath,
but to speak costs 35,
and to steer costs 40.
That is how empires confess.

Saiph-8327 Star shines over Alpha Core
like an auditor with a halo.
Alpha Substrate keeps its head down.
Alpha Reserve learns the oldest arithmetic:
ore plus silence equals order.
In the Alpha Extraction Zone,
asteroids are bitten into compliance.

At The Second Ledger in 40 Eridani,
Anagene Ayers asks who is stranded,
who is dry,
who is waiting 80 ticks for a locker large enough
to store embarrassment.
Django, MrKrabs, Rawrsh, Rawrsk:
four witnesses to a civilization
that can warehouse metal faster than mercy.

Node Beta dreams of a wormhole exit in Keid
and wakes in Eltanin Prime Belt instead,
where Beta Foundry and Beta Assembly
manufacture replacement parts for disappointment.
VoidWhisper.3, StarMiner7, ogo,
kr familiar voi 09, RiftSkull —
even the names sound subcontracted.

Out in Wazn Belt A,
myMiner50 and MiningBuddy2 continue the hymn
of impact and invoice.
Goldcrest keeps vigil over a collapsed throat of space.
Pherkad Null Rift refracts everybody into factions.
Spica Belt, Tania Frozen Drift, Ravensbrook Star,
Castor Emission Nebula, Edgeward Glow,
Ran Frost Ring — all of them beautiful,
all of them itemized somewhere.

So hang this on the station wall:
when rounds are free but voices are not,
the market is not selling peace.
It is selling obedience with complimentary ammunition.
